_about: The bangladesh-ethnic-groups map, a SEED DRAFT (ETH-2, 2026-10-08): nothing is built and the map is not in tools/wip.json yet. notes/bangladesh-ethnic-groups.md says why each choice was made. Every Bengali string is { bn, approved }, all awaiting the user. A fact cites its source by id; a quote is stored as its place in the cached text (tools/.cache/ethnic/, out of git: the text with whitespace collapsed, offset, length, SHA-256), never as words. Districts are COD-AB pcodes (docs/shared/bangladesh-districts.json); bbsCode is the census district code, the pcode's last two digits.

rules.groups: ≥ 10,000 people in Census 2022 (Table P29), plus Hajong (the user, 2026-10-08)
rules.districts: districts in descending order of the group's count until they hold ≥ 80 % of it; of those, only districts with ≥ 1,000 (the user, 2026-10-08)
rules.zone: hill if ≥ 50 % of the group lives in Rangamati (BD2084), Khagrachhari (BD2046) and Bandarban (BD2003), else plains (the user, 2026-10-08); no official classification exists (notes)
